description: This file defines a static class 'OrleansJsonSerializerSettings' that provides methods to configure and update JSON serializer settings for the Orleans framework, including default settings, custom configurations, and extension methods for serialization options.

classes.name: OrleansJsonSerializerSettings
classes.description: A static class providing methods to get and configure JSON serializer settings for Orleans serialization.

methods.name: GetDefaultSerializerSettings
methods.description: Returns a default configured JsonSerializerSettings instance with Orleans-specific settings.

methods.name: GetDefaultSerializerSettings (overload)
methods.description: Returns default serializer settings and applies additional configuration based on the provided IServiceProvider.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a JsonSerializerSettings instance by setting its SerializationBinder and adding custom converters.

methods.name: UpdateSerializerSettings
methods.description: Updates a given JsonSerializerSettings instance with options for full assembly names, indentation, and type name handling.
